title: Context transcription factors establish cooperative environments and mediate enhancer communication
authors: Kribelbauer JF; Pushkarev O; Gardeux V; Russeil J; van Mierlo G; Deplancke B
one_liner_zh: 该文通过caQTL分析研究转录因子协同环境与增强子通讯，但主要基于基因组统计与实验验证，缺乏AI或物理模拟方法，且未涉及三维互作建模。
abstract: Many enhancers play a crucial role in regulating gene expression by assembling regulatory factor (RF) clusters, also referred to as condensates. This process is essential for facilitating enhancer communication and establishing cellular identity. However, how DNA sequence and transcription factor (TF) binding instruct the formation of such high RF environments is still poorly understood. To address this, we developed a novel approach leveraging enhancer-centric chromatin accessibility quantitative trait loci (caQTLs) to nominate RF clusters genome-wide. By analyzing TF binding signatures within the context of caQTLs, we discovered a new class of TFs that specifically contributes to establishing cooperative environments. These “context-only” TFs bind promiscuously with cell type-specific pioneers, recruit coactivators, and, like super enhancers, render downstream gene expression sensitive to condensate-disrupting molecules. We further demonstrate that joint context-only and pioneer TF binding explains enhancer compatibility and provides a mechanistic rationale for how a loose TF syntax can still confer regulatory specificity.
abstract_zh: 许多增强子通过组装调控因子（RF）簇（也称为凝聚体）在调控基因表达中发挥关键作用。这一过程对于促进增强子通信和确立细胞身份至关重要。然而，DNA序列和转录因子（TF）结合如何指导这种高RF环境的形成仍知之甚少。为解决这一问题，我们开发了一种新方法，利用以增强子为中心的染色质可及性数量性状位点（caQTLs）在全基因组范围内提名RF簇。通过分析caQTLs背景下的TF结合特征，我们发现了一类新的TF，它们专门有助于建立协同环境。这些“仅上下文”TF与细胞类型特异性的先驱因子混杂结合，招募共激活因子，并像超级增强子一样，使下游基因表达对凝聚体破坏分子敏感。我们进一步证明，仅上下文TF与先驱TF的联合结合解释了增强子兼容性，并为松散的TF语法如何仍能赋予调控特异性提供了机制上的解释。
